commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Alejandro Hernandez has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+7' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Barcelona is cautioned for aggressive play. Free kick. Levante will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

90+1' 2 - 3 Unai Elgezabal Udondo (Levante) attempts to head the ball away after a cross into the penalty area, but instead he accidentally sends it under the roof of his own goal. The goalkeeper was helpless.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the free kick from the edge of the box, but the goalkeeper perfectly sets up the defensive wall and his effort is thwarted.
89' A yellow card for a tackle by Diego Varela Pampin (Levante). Alejandro Hernandez doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
88' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.

87' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
86' Julian Calero has decided to make a change. Victor Garcia (Levante) replaces Jeremy Toljan.
86' Diego Varela Pampin (Levante) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jules Kounde (Barcelona) will replace Eric Garcia.
84' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
84' That's unlucky! Raphinha (Barcelona) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
80' The referee awards a corner and Raphinha (Barcelona) goes over to take it.
79' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Pedri (Barcelona). Corner kick. Barcelona will have an opportunity.
78' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
78' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Dani Olmo (Barcelona) inside the box.
76' Substitution. Alejandro Balde is replaced by Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona).
76' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Ronald Araujo and he is replaced by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona).
75' A cooling break is underway.
75' Today's match ends for Manu Sanchez who will be replaced by Diego Varela Pampin (Levante).
75' It will be a substitution. Carlos Espi (Levante) is ready to enter the pitch as Roger Brugue walks off.
75' Julian Calero has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iker Losada (Levante) replacing Ivan Romero.
74' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

73' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Barcelona.

72' A neat pass is well received by Dani Olmo (Barcelona), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
72' Raphinha (Barcelona) swings in a cross from the corner, but Pablo Cunat reads it well and gathers the ball.
71' The attendance is 23415.

71' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Barcelona.
71' Oriol Rey (Levante) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
70' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the roof of the net. His effort, however, is blocked by Pablo Cunat, who pulls off a stunning save!
68' The game is interrupted now, Oriol Rey (Levante) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
67' Gavi (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Hernandez saw the whole situation. Levante have a free kick.
66' A pass from Roger Brugue (Levante) is intercepted by Joan Garcia and the move breaks down.
60' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
59' Here's the change. Jose Morales leaves the pitch and Carlos Alvarez (Levante) comes on as a substitute.
58' Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle after Jeremy Toljan (Levante) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Barcelona are awarded a free kick.

57' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) looks very eager to impress, does well to beat his man and force a cross into the box, where one of his teammates gets his head on the ball, but it's too easy for the keeper.

54' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
53' Jose Morales (Levante) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Joan Garcia makes a great save.

52' 2 - 2 Raphinha produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Ferran Torres (Barcelona) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the top of the net. What a brilliant finish. 2:2.
51' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
49' 2 - 1 Goal! Lamine Yamal sets up Pedri (Barcelona) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the top right corner. 2:1.
49' Raphinha (Barcelona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

48' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) blew a promising chance when he got to a rebound just outside the penalty area. He struck it towards the middle of the target, but Pablo Cunat pulled off a nice save to stop the attempt.
48' Raphinha (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
46' Jose Morales (Levante) sees a yellow card from Alejandro Hernandez after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
46' The game is over for Marcus Rashford (Barcelona). Dani Olmo comes on for the second half.
46' Hansi Flick makes a switch. Gavi is coming on in place of Marc Casado (Barcelona) at the start of the second period.
46' Referee Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle to start the second half.

46' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Barcelona.
45+9' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Jose Morales (Levante) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Joan Garcia no chance!
45+7' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Levante!

45+7' There's a break in play and referee Alejandro Hernandez must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Levante using VAR. This could be interesting!
45+6' That looked a certain handball by Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
45+5' Jose Morales (Levante) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Levante get a corner.

45+4' Raphinha (Barcelona) attempts to beat the goalkeeper with an accurate shot from the free kick, which is placed dangerously close to the penalty area. However, Pablo Cunat pulls off a great save to stop his attempt towards the roof of the net.
45+3' Today's referee Alejandro Hernandez rightly decides to book Pablo Martinez Andres (Levante) for his harsh tackle.
45+2' Raphinha (Barcelona) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
45+2' Barcelona win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

45+1' Raphinha (Barcelona) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
45' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
44' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is yellow-carded.
44' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

42' Roger Brugue (Levante) launches himself at the ball from the free kick and produces a header which lacks accuracy, sending it just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
41' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Hernandez blows his whistle for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Levante.
40' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Pablo Cunat is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.

37' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Levante.
36' Pedri (Barcelona) latches on to a pass on the edge of the box, but he can't get any power into the shot and fails to trouble Pablo Cunat.
35' Roger Brugue (Levante) is flagged for offside.
32' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
30' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
30' Marc Casado (Barcelona) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
30' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
28' Pablo Cunat pulls off a great save to deny Ferran Torres (Barcelona), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
26' Pedri (Barcelona) receives a short pass and produces a low effort from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and makes a routine save.
25' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
25' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
24' A pass lands at the feet of Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.

21' Raphinha (Barcelona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Alejandro Hernandez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Levante in a dangerous position.
21' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Pablo Cunat comes off his line to gather the ball.
20' Barcelona are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
19' Marc Casado (Barcelona) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Ivan Romero (Levante) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Jeremy Toljan, then sends the ball into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
14' The corner from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is cleared away by the defence.
13' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.
12' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Pablo Cunat, who smothers the ball.
12' Jose Morales (Levante) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.
10' Marc Casado (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Barcelona win a corner.
9' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
9' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Jose Morales (Levante) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
5' Raphinha (Barcelona) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Levante will have a goal kick.
5' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) works the corner short.
5' Half-chance! Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) plays a pass into the box, but Pablo Cunat reacts well to snuff out the attack. The referee signals a corner kick to Barcelona.
5' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona). The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
2' Levante are ruled offside.
